question: Icedrive: the record storage/icedrive carries extras.dead_end with retry_when "never; the service is gone", and a third-party directory lists an S3 endpoint and rclone compatibility while the vendor help page says WebDAV is disabled for new users. Which interface list is right, and should the extras.dead_end block be rewritten?
why: The verdict is proposed as fails-quota because icedrive.net is live with a 10 GB free tier; the extras block still says the service is gone, and a lane cannot edit extras.
